title: It was supposed to be a city
body: Walt's original plan for this land was not a theme park. It was an experimental city where about 20,000 people would live and work, with a covered downtown, monorails and people movers for getting around, and cars kept underground. After his death the company set the city aside and opened this park in October 1982 as something like a permanent world's fair instead: half future technology, half international pavilions.
